sources.quote: Messier 32 is a dwarf "early-type" galaxy about 2,490,000 light-years (760,000 pc) from the Solar System, appearing in the constellation Andromeda.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, standing as a flat picture that faces the Sun.

sources.quote: M32 is a satellite galaxy of the Andromeda Galaxy (M31) and was discovered by Guillaume Le Gentil in 1749.
